250.en: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
Originator of the heavens and the earth. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

251.en: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.
Allah destroys interest and gives increase for charities. And Allah does not like every sinning disbeliever.
Say, "Obey Allah and the Messenger." But if they turn away - then indeed, Allah does not like the disbelievers.

252.en: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy... and because Allah is Accepting of repentance and Wise.
[It is] as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.

253.en: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.
And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?

254.en: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?
And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you and to the believers is kind and merciful.

255.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

256.en: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of one another and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?
He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil instead of good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allah that you may receive mercy?"

257.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book.
And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

258.en: And thus have We sent the Qur'an down as verses of clear evidence and because Allah guides whom He intends.

259.en: Those are the disbelievers, truly. And We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment.
That He may question the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment.
And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment.

260.en: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.

261.en: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."
So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver.

262.en: And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves."
They call upon instead of Him none but female [deities], and they [actually] call upon none but a rebellious Satan.
Indeed, Allah knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

263.en: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
[Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

264.en: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away?
Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?

265.en: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.
They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.

266.en: To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent."
And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is over all things competent.
Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

267.en: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
[Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.

g: and that We (may) make it clear
268.en: And thus do We diversify the verses so the disbelievers will say, "You have studied," and so We may make the Qur'an clear for a people who know.
[Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.

269.en: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."
Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them.

270.en: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,
He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allah] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment.
So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised."

271.en: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.
And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.

272.en: Allah has prepared for them gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide eternally. That is the great attainment.
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

273.en: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

274.en: Said the eminent among his people, "Indeed, we see you in clear error."
And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner
So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].

275.en: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.

g: and he will be made to drink
275.en: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.

g: surely We (would) have given them to drink
275.en: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

276.en: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.
To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

277.en: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.

278.en: Know that Allah is severe in penalty and that Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe.
Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.

279.en: Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion [Muhammad] no madness. He is not but a clear warner.
Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

280.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

281.en: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
In the victory of Allah. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

282.en: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."

283.en: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
[He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
And you had certainly wished for martyrdom before you encountered it, and you have [now] seen it [before you] while you were looking on.

284.en: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And ever is Allah, of all things, encompassing.

285.en: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.

286.en: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.

287.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
Allah warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.

288.en: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver.

289.en: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

290.en: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
But as for those whose faces will turn white, [they will be] within the mercy of Allah. They will abide therein eternally.

291.en: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allah is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muhammad], are not over them a manager.
Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.

292.en: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.
Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.

293.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

294.en: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned [all] matters.
And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is over all things competent.
And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the destination.

295.en: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and to those before you - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

296.en: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.
And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.

297.en: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
But they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

298.en: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

299.en: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
